chipSemantics.outputRate: Configured outputrate; each frame addsclock to integerphase, runs floor(phase/rate) clockticks and averages per-tick floatoutputs in double. Fraction retained acrosschunks. Count0returns heldlasttickPCM; notclock/72, notRFsample-and-hold atdividedtick.
chipSemantics.channelsWaveRam: Six audible channels,8entry selected-registerstorage. Channelindex6/7 safe/silent but selection canwrite theirlatches. Each32fivebitwavewords; channelperiod12-bit withzero4096; enablebit7, DDA bit6. DDA1to0 resetswaveindex; enable0to1reloadstick. Wavewrite masks5bits andincrementsindex onlydisabled; DDAwrites updateDAC withoutoverwritingWaveRAM.
chipSemantics.mixing: Channelvolume5bits, perchannel/globalstereobalance nonlinear16-entryscale; highnibbleleft/lownibbleright. Combinedattenuation clamped31, lookup31exactzero. Per-voice enabledoscillatorsadvance evenhostmuted; hostmute onlychangeslevelsontick, heldsamplecanpersistifcount0. No analogfilter/physicalaccuracyclaim.
chipSemantics.noiseLfo: Noise onlyaudiblechannels4/5, seeded1; counterreload=(31-freq)*64, freq31=>everytick,18bitfeedbacktaps0/1/11/12/17. LFO CH1(index1) waveformmodulatesCH0period withdepth1/4/16; resetbit7 controlsindex/tick, sourcevoiceisnotmuted automatically. ExistingMAMEimperfectnoise/LFO behavior retained.
chipSemantics.registers: Write aliases low4bits; data truncatedbyte, frequencyhighmasked4bits. No read/status/IRQ/state/hooksC ABI. Publicwrapper tracks selectedChannel authoring latch only, notcorestate.
chipSemantics.stream: writeHuc6280Stream(port,register,value): explicitport writes selectregister(register>>>4), writeslow4register, restorespriorselection; portFF skips temporaryselect+restore, retainingcurrentselection. Directregister0 writesupdateJSselectedChannel.
chipSemantics.publicEngine: Public low-levelwrapper is Huc6280AudioEngine, not huc6280.js. create validatesintegerclock1..3FFFFFFF andoutputrate8000..384000; moduleFactory injection. processFrames returnsownedcopies, volume0..3.8 clamp; currentheapread aftergenerate/growth, size0earlyreturn. processFrames disposedguard; no genericwrite/resetdisposedguard promise. No borrowedView/reserve/Into orsnapshotmethods.

reports.method: Actual generated JS/WASM through unchanged Huc6280AudioEngine, exact owned configured-rate stereo PCM, control endpoint observations and continued97-frame probes. Independent wave/DDA/noise integer models and actual VgmPlayer b9/type05/1b streams, reset and zero-prefix seek. No native snapshots, fabricated state ABI, mock, tolerance, Mixer or audio device.
limits: HuC output averages all integer chip-clock tick samples per configured output frame; phase adds clock then divides/modulos output rate. If no native tick occurs, the previous held sample remains. UnlikeRF5C164, reset does not force an initial immediate native tick.

Only6physical channels produce output; internal selectors6/7 and unusedregisters10..15 remain inert for sound. Tests cover32wave entries, off/on write-index behavior, DDA-to-wave index reset,12-bit periods including0 initial-counter transient, independent channel/global balance attenuation,5-bit DDA and master-volume scaling.

Noise is available onlyCH4/5 and precedes DDA. All32rates on both voices are compared against an independent18-bit LFSR/divider and64-tick average model. LFO four depths and resetbit are audible controls; mutingCH1 suppresses its output but retains its modulation contribution.

There is no native/public snapshot, save/load, read/status, IRQ or borrowed/Into API. Equality covers exact PCM, independent control positives, observable selectedChannel/masterVolume/rate, reset/replay and continued probes; it does not claim inaccessible internal state equivalence. Current lowlevel createSoundChip factory has noHuC loader, so none is invented here.

Reset clears waveform RAM, registers, oscillator/noise/LFO counters and held/fractional output but retains mute flags and public volume. Reset/replay cases explicitly restore neutral mutes/volume before reset. Muted voices keep advancing; veryslow native clocks can retain old audible samples until nexttick.

Returned processFrames arrays are owned. Actual references survive later synthesis, buffer-capacity growth, real WASM heap growth and disposal. Only existing disposed processFrames guards are asserted; no unsafe extra call on nativehandle0 is made.

Real VgmPlayer fixtures exercise b9 registers, original type05 data, chip1b DDA streams, explicitport selection/restore and FF current-channel routing, timed ordering, loop/stop and seek-by-replay fromzero. No unsupported checkpoints or opaque HuC states are asserted. Native tick loops and Player delivered frames are not output frames to add again.
No Browser/Worklet scheduling, Native backend, physical hardware or listening judgement is tested.
